test_gtn_graph_equality: test two gtn graphs for equality using gtn.equal comparing nodes, arcs, labels, and weights
test_gtn_graph_isomorphism: test two gtn graphs for structural isomorphism using gtn.isomorphic ignoring node ordering
test_gtn_loadtxt_savetxt: test loading and saving gtn graphs to text format using gtn.loadtxt and gtn.savetxt
test_gtn_save_load: test saving and loading gtn graphs to binary format using gtn.save and gtn.load
test_gtn_graph_construction: test building gtn graphs with add_node and add_arc including start, accept, and epsilon nodes
